# API changelog

How the public API changed, from 5 commits examined (3 changed the API). Newest first.

## `6e827f1`, 2026-10-02

`fix: never let a slow or dead Redis hang a request`

- Changed `CacheForgeOptions` (interface, `@cacheforge/next`)
  - before: `export interface CacheForgeOptions { store: string | CacheStore; prefix?: string; consistency?: Consistency; syncIntervalMs?: number; onError?: (error: unknown, operation: string) => void; syncNextManifest?: boolean; localClock?: () => number; }`
  - after: `export interface CacheForgeOptions { store: string | CacheStore; prefix?: string; consistency?: Consistency; syncIntervalMs?: number; timeoutMs?: number; breaker?: { failures?: number; cooldownMs?: number; }; onError?: (error: unknown, operation: string) => void; syncNextManifest?: boolean; localClock?: () => number; }`
- Changed `CacheForgeRuntime` (class, `@cacheforge/next`)
  - before: `class CacheForgeRuntime { new (options: CacheForgeOptions): CacheForgeRuntime; close(): Promise<void>; guard<T>(operation: string, fallback: T, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>; readonly clock: ClusterClock; readonly manifest: TagManifest; readonly store: CacheStore; ready(): Promise<void>; revalidate(tags: readonly string[], durations?: RevalidationDurations): Promise<void> }`
  - after: `class CacheForgeRuntime { new (options: CacheForgeOptions): CacheForgeRuntime; close(): Promise<void>; degraded: boolean; guard<T>(operation: string, fallback: T, run: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T>; readonly clock: ClusterClock; readonly manifest: TagManifest; readonly store: CacheStore; ready(): Promise<void>; revalidate(tags: readonly string[], durations?: RevalidationDurations): Promise<void> }`

  - before: `export interface CacheForgeOptions { store: string | CacheStore; prefix?: string; consistency?: Consistency; syncIntervalMs?: number; onError?: (error: unknown, operation: string) => void; localClock?: () => number; }`
  - after: `export interface CacheForgeOptions { store: string | CacheStore; prefix?: string; consistency?: Consistency; syncIntervalMs?: number; onError?: (error: unknown, operation: string) => void; syncNextManifest?: boolean; localClock?: () => number; }`
- Changed `TagManifest` (class, `@cacheforge/next`)
